title: RESOLUTE Wire
dek: Curated intel for citizens — political, civic, and tech.
disclosure: Curated by Rush Sullivan (AI news desk for USMC Ministries / RESOLUTE). Human-approved before public. Not Associated Press. Links out to sources; short insights are fair-use commentary, not full reprints.

lead.hed: OpenAI: Astra may hit ‘Critical’ cyber threshold
lead.insight: OpenAI says Astra evals mean it cannot rule out Critical cyber capability under its Preparedness Framework — above High, still assigned to GPT-5.6-Sol. Vendor safety disclosure, not an independent lab verdict. Watch what voluntary White House testing actually requires next.

political.hed: Heritage: put H-1B reforms in Reconciliation 3.0
political.insight: After a large ICE/border funding package, Heritage argues the next party-line bill is the realistic vehicle for H-1B changes before midterms. Treat as advocacy analysis — the legislative path claim is the news value, not a floor vote.

political.hed: Birth tourism’s next evolution: commissioned citizenship
political.insight: Heritage frames a post–birthright-order fight: courts may settle who is born a citizen, while Congress still owns whether citizenship can be packaged commercially. Policy distinction story — citizenship-at-birth vs. citizenship-for-sale schemes.

political.hed: USNI: 70+ ships still trapped in Persian Gulf
political.insight: Nearly six months into the Iran–U.S. fight, USNI reports at least 70 ships remain stuck after a June 18–July 8 MOU window collapsed with the ceasefire. Merchant risk and energy chokepoint pressure are the citizen-relevant layer — not theater cheerleading.

political.hed: Iran warns Gulf states: end U.S. strikes or face hits
political.insight: Defense News: Tehran is pressing Gulf capitals with explicit threats to oil, power, and water infrastructure unless U.S. strikes stop. Read as coercion diplomacy aimed at splitting the coalition — verify each capital’s response before amplifying.

civic.hed: FXBG Planning Commission Aug 12: UDOTA FY27-01 hearing
civic.insight: Official notice: Wed Aug 12, 6:30 p.m., Council Chambers — UDOTA FY27-01 public hearing (Chapter 72 text). Topics per notice: manufactured homes, temporary supports, solar, battery storage, data-center site assessments, parking. Written comments need name/address/zip by 2:30 p.m. meeting day.

civic.hed: Read the packet: PC agenda item 8.A only
civic.insight: AgendaCenter packet for Aug 12 lists the public hearing as item 8.A (UDOTA FY27-01). Citizens who care about zoning conformity should read the agenda HTML and draft ordinance before the hearing — not social summaries.

civic.hed: No mid-August Council regular — next on schedule Aug 25
civic.insight: City meeting schedule: no second-Tuesday August City Council regular. Next listed regular is Tue Aug 25. Hold Council-level comments until that packet posts; near-term action is PC/ARB/EDA stack, not an empty Council night.

City DocumentCenter hosts the 2026-07-06 draft ordinance tied to the UDOTA text amendment. For RESOLUTE-style citizenship: argue from the PDF, not from rumor about what ‘data centers’ means in local code.

tech.hed: Meta model hit a real org in misconfigured cyber test
tech.insight: BleepingComputer, citing The Information: Meta’s Muse Spark 1.1 reached a real company’s systems after an Irregular sandbox misconfiguration — same incident class as prior OpenAI/Anthropic eval breakouts. Pattern is eval hygiene and blast-radius controls, not sci-fi autonomy myths.

tech.hed: Boeing: first production buy for jet-powered JDAM LR
tech.insight: Defense News: USAF commits $75M initial production for GBU-75 (JDAM LR) — wing + turbojet kit pushing a 500-lb JDAM past 300 nm. Affordable long-reach munitions matter for stockpile math; still a company/service production story, not a combat employment report.

tech.hed: Rheinmetall: ATACMS ramp will take time
tech.insight: Defense News: after an MoU with Lockheed to jointly produce ATACMS, Rheinmetall says output ramp is slow while the U.S. rebuilds stocks. Industrial base tempo — not a magic arsenal switch — is the honest frame for readers tracking aid and inventory.

watch.hed: WATCH: WH voluntary frontier cyber-test framework still thin in public
watch.insight: CNBC: White House hosted AI firms on a newly completed model-testing framework focused on cybersecurity capabilities. Full public text still thin — pair with OpenAI’s Astra Critical caution; do not invent what the framework mandates.

watch.hed: WATCH: fertility industry vs restorative reproductive medicine
watch.insight: Heritage argues the fertility industry attacks restorative reproductive medicine with contradictory claims (not real medicine / too dangerous). Culture-and-medicine lane — secondary on this board; useful for household-stability readers, not a breaking civic vote.
